run_precompute_enumerate_surface: run the script to enumerate and pickle surface structures for a given bulk crystal index
build_enumerate_surfaces_for_saving: build a list of symmetrically distinct surface slabs from a bulk ASE Atoms object
create_standardize_bulk: create a standardized conventional unit cell structure from an ASE Atoms bulk object
test_is_structure_invertible: test whether a pymatgen Structure has z-direction symmetry that makes top and bottom equivalent
refactor_flip_struct: refactor a pymatgen Structure by flipping it upside down along the z-axis
